description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: wooden lobster trap cage, iron ship anchor, barrel of fresh fish, red and white striped buoy, stack of empty wooden fish crates, pile of fishing nets with cork floats, wooden rack of drying fish, wooden crate of salt sacks, round fishing net wreath woven with white flowers, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
